description: This file defines the 'Gamma' class with methods to calculate gamma function values, gamma distribution, inverse gamma distribution, and natural logarithm of gamma function, specifically for statistical calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Gamma
classes.description: A class providing statistical gamma function calculations such as gamma, distribution, inverse distribution, and the natural log of gamma.

methods.name: gamma
methods.description: Calculates the gamma function for a given float or array of floats.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Returns the gamma distribution or its cumulative distribution function (CDF) or probability density function (PDF) based on the parameters.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the gamma distribution (quantile function) given a probability and distribution parameters.

methods.name: ln
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the gamma function at a given value.
